name: formcut community packages
description: Effect packages anyone can install from the effects browser. Each entry names a zip of a package folder (manifest.json plus its shader.wgsl or audio template) hosted anywhere; the engine downloads it, checks it the way the loader checks every package, and installs it. To list a package here, open a pull request adding an entry.
